desc:
Various systems have been reworked including scenario selection and FX - and even more features have been added to private servers in the 7.0 update! Double XP event is extended until November!

Join back daily for new rewards, including in-game currency!

✨ Welcome to the new Submarine Life (formerly Submarine Roleplay 2)! Serve aboard the USS Missouri - simulate life on a nuclear powered Virginia-class submarine - and work together to keep peace at sea with the United States Navy.

✅ If you enjoy the game, please give it a like! Big updates are in development.

':chatlogs true'

🔱 Join our group, MRPC, for in game perks and features, as well as getting access to chat functions in our Server.
